correctness_argument: Changes no arithmetic, target, mask, split, metric, gate, threshold, protocol or data. The mask is a process configuration, not a scientific constant. No evaluation outcome was observed before the fix and none influenced it.
defect: Module-level CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="" executed on import. ephemeral_pages_conditional.leaf_truth_guard imports this module for truth helpers, so importing it hid a live GPU from the entire conditional process and every CUDA conditional fit aborted with "CUDA requested but unavailable" before any optimizer step. Two independent smoke attempts failed identically; no model, target, metric or gate was involved.
fix: Scope the CPU-only device mask to direct execution (__name__ == "__main__"). The component CLI still runs CPU-only; library importers keep whatever device the caller configured.
replication_requirement: Both component parts rerun in a new exclusive root under the corrected code, and all previously read component/linear numbers are compared against the rerun before use.
